extraction_notes: Main-text catalytic performance figures digitised: Figure 1a–d and Figure 2a–d. Figures 3–8 were skipped because they are characterization or operando spectroscopy rather than measured catalytic performance; Figure 8 reports normalized DRIFTS intermediate intensities, not conversion/selectivity/STY/rate. In Figure 1a,b there appears to be a possible extra marker between 10 and 20 wt% CuO; because the Experimental section and provided catalyst-name list only define 4, 10, 20, 30, and 40 wt% CuO catalysts, that ambiguous possible point was not assigned as a separate catalyst.
